data.name: Maleeha
data.gender_notes: Maleeha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Malihah' which means soft, kind, gentle. The name Maleeha carries the meaning “Soft, Kind, Gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maleeha usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, kind, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Maleeha is often associated with beauty, grace, and compassion.
data.etymology: Maleeha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, Kind, Gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maleeha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
